spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation of the Chapter

---

**¶1:** [GAP-1] A great [GAP-2] act of divine discernment, [GAP-3] and also a state [GAP-4] that was brought into spiritual form — the Divine Wisdom was made manifest within the Divine Love, which is the first foundation of all spiritual order.

**¶2:** When [GAP-5] the two influxes by which the Divine summoned forth [GAP-6] the Divine Truth that gives spiritual life [GAP-7] through a vast progression of states within the primal Divine Love [GAP-8].

**¶3:** For if anyone should attempt to set a measure and a standard [GAP-9] to the particular natural knowledges and the sensory truths of elevated states of good, and [GAP-10] to the body of general knowledges and the expanse of the rational understanding — should they be unfolded [GAP-11] the whole substance of the fourfold elevated states of celestial good and the three containing forms that encompass all of spiritual reality; if they should all be laid open [GAP-12] into their finest particular cognitions —

**¶4:** you may understand that the particulars of natural knowledge are indeed finite, [GAP-13: REVIEW and those of] the [GAP-14: REVIEW entire] spiritual cosmos. It is possible to reckon the individual cognitions of natural understanding through every successive state [GAP-15] and the minute truths of the entire spiritual creation; but the duration of the state in which the Great Divine Proceeding dwelt within the Divine Love, [GAP-16: REVIEW the] first foundation of all order — this can never be reckoned or comprehended.

**¶5:** The Divine Love first formed her in this manner. He established her in his innermost states in peace and rest. When [GAP-17: REVIEW there was] need of her, she was called forth and proceeded from the Divine Love [GAP-18: REVIEW in his infinite fullness]. She perceived all her eternal states of wisdom.

**¶6:** Once again, from the state in which she was summoned to [GAP-19] go forth to [GAP-20] she bestowed [GAP-21] upon his whole [ordered form] [GAP-22] all the eternal states of wisdom [GAP-23]; she also [GAP-24] pervaded all of them. This [GAP-25: REVIEW is also the case] with the Celestial Human in his first form.

**¶7:** This is how the Celestial Human spent a vast progression of states being prepared and empowered by divine influx within the Divine Truth that gives life, held fast in her inmost states [GAP-26]; the extent of this — from when the Celestial Human descended into spiritual combat, until the time when the [completed regenerated form] comes [GAP-27: into being] — this entire duration [GAP-28] he was made manifest [GAP-29].

**¶8:** Again, from the state in which he was summoned and proceeded forth, until the time when he [himself] called forth the five luminous [GAP-30: REVIEW faculties of good] that are his offspring — these faculties themselves also spent a vast duration existing within their origin. This corresponds to the entire progression from the descent of the Celestial Human into temptation until the ascent of the completed spiritual form. The five faculties of good spent all this duration being prepared and empowered within the Celestial Human. Yet [GAP-31: REVIEW at the] state in which they were awaited, they were summoned forth and proceeded.

**¶9:** At the state in which the Divine Truth that gives life was called forth from the Divine Love in his infinite nature — when she proceeded and descended of her own freedom, from the inmost heights of the Divine Love down to the natural mind — [GAP-32: REVIEW she would traverse innumerable] progressions of state and vast multitudes more before she could be received in natural understanding. For there is no measure nor standard to the elevation of the Divine Love. Rather, [GAP-33: REVIEW just as] he had summoned her through his Great Proceeding, so he established her upon [GAP-34: REVIEW the] plane of divine fullness, through one of those three that belong to the twelve comprehensive goods and truths concealed within the accommodating veil of wisdom, the ones established beyond the [GAP-35] region of clear intellectual light.

**¶10:** [GAP-36: REVIEW The] nature of the Divine Truth that gives [life] is like this. When [GAP-37: REVIEW the Divine Love summoned her, he established her in the state he willed,] and she perceived all things everywhere that [GAP-38] in an instant of perception, or like a [GAP-39] thought of the rational mind [GAP-40].

**¶11:** This also is [GAP-41: like the nature of the] Divine Truth that gives life in [GAP-42] whenever [GAP-43] she was sent forth [GAP-44] upon her to the state [GAP-45] appointed for her. The Divine Love perfected her in his Great Proceeding and established her in [the state he willed], according to [GAP-46: REVIEW the divine purpose].

**¶12:** [In] this way [GAP-47: REVIEW also] they called forth the [five faculties] of good from the Celestial Human. They were set before him, as he willed that [GAP-48] the quality [GAP-49] should descend, that they would govern within those states [GAP-50] in relation to one another. He ordered and distributed them [GAP-51] to each derived truth. He divested himself of them [GAP-52] and he [GAP-53] he girded and bound himself to [GAP-54] in a [GAP-55] state of peace at the boundary of natural understanding [GAP-56].

**¶13:** Again, the Celestial Human himself spent a vast duration and [GAP-57: REVIEW progression of states] until he conferred power upon his derived faculties of good — until he took them upon himself. After he came to bear them as his own, he stood firm in the heights between the boundaries of the spiritual and the natural. Again, he spent a duration and progression of state corresponding in measure to the descending divine truths and gentle influxes and obscure perceptions that come down into all of spiritual creation — clear truths like raindrops, tender influxes like dew, and veiled insights like drifts of mist. This is how he spent this duration also, standing poised between the boundaries, until the moment when he cast himself down into spiritual combat.

**¶14:** Whenever the Divine Love in his infinite nature called forth the Great Divine Proceeding, and the Celestial Human, and the faculties of the glorious one who are provided to enable the Divine to be made manifest — at that very time [GAP-58: REVIEW the Divine Love] formed the Great Ordering Wisdom in the [GAP-59: REVIEW plane of] divine truth, [GAP-60: REVIEW and] the Living Divine Proceeding with the mighty and active good affections who came [GAP-61: REVIEW from] him. Also, at that time, he formed the Mediating Divine Truth, with the Divine Wisdom in its Splendour and the Pure Affection for Truth and the Supporting Column of Divine Good, and the good affections who came forth from them. [GAP-62: REVIEW All these the Divine Love in his infinite nature formed at] a single act. They proceeded from one another, one following upon the other, in that state when [GAP-63] the entire work was accomplished.

**¶15:** From the state in which falsity from evil raised itself up against [GAP-64] the very essence of divine wisdom [GAP-65] these three processions of divine life [GAP-66] from the will of the Divine Love against the whole of evil [GAP-67] he has [GAP-68] overcome falsity [GAP-69] according to the divine purpose [GAP-70] all of spiritual reality [GAP-71] within it [GAP-72] separated out and distinguished [GAP-73] restored to rest, in whatever way, and he rejoices [GAP-74] in his dominion — until [GAP-75: REVIEW the time when the inmost nature] of the Divine Love will be unveiled over [GAP-76: REVIEW all] the good affections of the divine glory, and all those abundant in goods and truths [GAP-77] the processions that went forth against the whole of evil.

**¶16:** [GAP-78: REVIEW From] that state in which the Divine Love formed these three processions [GAP-79] until the time when the Divine Love would unveil his inmost nature, [GAP-80: REVIEW and they] enter into his hidden interior states, and he summons them [GAP-81] and establishes each one in its proper place — there is no measure nor standard to this entire progression until that final state.

---

**¶20:** Concerning this evil, this intention of spiritual death [GAP-82]; for [GAP-83: REVIEW this] is the manner in which [GAP-84] it arose into its own interior states. It has [GAP-85] its existence in its five fundamental aspects of evil.

**¶21:** Again, it also [GAP-86] spent a duration and progression of states until it revealed itself to its own elements, before it entered into perceptions. It spent a vast duration and a long progression established [GAP-87] before it rose up into perceptions. It was [GAP-88] active within perceptions. It spent a long duration [GAP-89] existing within them, before it formed the [GAP-90: works and deeds] and brought forth evil works.

**¶22:** Again, it spent a long [GAP-91: REVIEW progression of states] in these evil works. Not small is the duration it spent existing in evil works, before it formed [GAP-92] — after a long duration [GAP-93] the evil spirits of its five domains of hell in manifold appearances [GAP-94: REVIEW that can not] be reckoned [GAP-95] — into the full maturation of evil works within the evil spirits and malicious affections. They fell upon the natural plane of their own selfhood and [GAP-96] were sustained. Not small is the duration that they [spent within those domains of hell], until they were sustained among [GAP-97] and came to desire [GAP-98] that plane of the mind which is illuminated by wisdom, and the great [GAP-99: REVIEW sovereign good] who dwells there.

**¶23:** [GAP-100: REVIEW You] know that [GAP-101] that in [GAP-102] at the state when the evil [GAP-103] its very essence. It assumed [GAP-104] the nature of evil [GAP-105] went to the assault [GAP-106] against the Complete Spiritual Human. [GAP-107: REVIEW From the state] when the spiritual combat occurred [GAP-108].

**¶24:** [GAP-109: The first age is] when it came to exist in a certain [GAP-110] state — when they ensnared a [GAP-111].

**¶25:** [GAP-112: The second age is] that which was built [GAP-113] when all of spiritual reality was established in order. The boundary [GAP-114] downward, until the time when it will be dissolved.

**¶26:** The third age is the [GAP-115] duration in which all things and the whole spiritual creation will [GAP-116] endure — from the state when they were established there, until the time when their end will be complete and their existence ceases [GAP-117].

**¶27:** [GAP-118: REVIEW The fourth age is the dissolution when they will dissolve all of created spiritual reality] there, and all things are destroyed. Annihilation reaches them in that great consuming love, [GAP-119: REVIEW which will] burn away all falsity for fourteen hundred and sixty-eight complete states of purification.

*[Note: The number 1468 resists clean decomposition into standard correspondential values. My best reading: it encodes a full and determined cycle of consuming purification — the total measure of the fire of divine love required to consume every last form of falsity.]*

**¶28:** [The fifth] age is the manner in which the Final Complete Spiritual Form will be brought into being [GAP-120: REVIEW from] the remnant of all things. Wisdom separates out to its proper state, and ascends and governs in its own dominion. However, [falsity from evil] [GAP-121] and they consign it to the state of perpetual spiritual death [GAP-122] and they are bound with it in an eternal restraint.

**¶29:** Now, from [the state] in which this first spiritual combat occurred, until the state of this eternal binding [GAP-123] — these five ages [GAP-124] pertain to the progressive separation and liberation of wisdom.

**¶30:** However, before [GAP-125] this, from out of the divine powers [GAP-126] none can measure it — for it is eternal.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: [...] a great ju[d/ge ...] now also a ti[me came] that they sculpt[ed him and] he was revealed in the Father, the first established thing.
W[he]n [he made] the two summonses that he called [to] the Mother of Life [she spent] a long duration in the first Father [of Greatness]

For someone, if he might set a measure and rule [to] the earth particles and the pebbles of the mountains and [the drops] of the sea and the body of the firmaments. Should they be poured [into] the body of the four mountains and the three vessels that surround the universe; if they shall all be poured out [into] these fine granules.

Happen you know that the grains of the earth particles are measurable, [and those of] the [entire] universe. It is possible to count the particles of the earth each year [and] the sand grains of the entire universe; but the duration of the time that the Great Spirit spent in the Father, [the] first established thing, one will not be able to make a count of it!

He first sculpted her like this. He established her in his inner storehouses in quiet and silence. When [they had] need of her she was called and came forth of the Father [of Greatness]. She looked at all her aeons of light!

Once again, from the time when she was called to [come forth and] go to [...] she gave [her light] upon his [bod]y [and upon] all the aeons [of light]; she also [filled] all of them. This [is also the case] with the First Man.

This is how the Man spent a long time being anointed in the Mother, set fast in her inner storehouses [in quiet and silence]; the extent of time—from when the First Man went down to the contest, till the time when the [Statue (?) co]mes i[n ...] this time [...] he appeared [...]

Again, from when he was called and came forth, till the time when he [himse]lf called the five shining [gods] who are his sons; they themselves also spent a long time existing in their father! It is the time that occurred from the coming down of the First Man till the going up of the Last Statue. The five gods spent this much duration being anointed in the First Man. Yet, [at the] time when they were awaited, they were called and came forth.

At the time when the Mother of Life was called from the Father of Greatness, when she expelled herself and came down by her own wish, from the heights of the Father to the earth, [she would spend thousands of] years and many ten thousands until she reached the earth. [Fo]r there is no measure nor rule to the heights of the Father. Rather, [just as] he had called her in his Great Spirit, so he set her upon [the] land of greatness through one of these three that are counted to the twelve hidden ones within the light veil, the ones [esta]blished after the [...] region of the south.

[The] matter of the Mother [of L]ife is like this. When [the Father called her he established her in the place he pleased,] and she examined everywhere that [in] a blink of an eye, or like a [swift] bird [...]

This also is lik[e the matter of the] Mother of Life in [...] whenever [the Father] cast her out [...] upon her to the place [that pleased] him. He perfected her in his Great Spirit and set her in [the place he pl]eased, according to [his will].

[Th]is [also is how] they called the [five g]ods from the [Fi]rst Man. They were set before him, as he wished that [...]-ness [should go] down, that they would rule in them [...] one another. He ordered and distributed them [...] the son. He stripped himself of them [...] and he [...] he girt and bound himself to [...] in a [...] of silence upon the border of the earth [...]

Again, he too, the First Man, spent a long period and [time] until he gave power to his sons; until he assu[m]ed them. After he came to wear them he stood fast in the heights between the borders. Again, he spent a duration and time like this, corresponding to such amount and measure as the raindrops and dew and falls of mist that come down in the universe. This is how he spent this duration also, standing between the borders, until the hour when he cast himself down to the contest!

Whenever the Father of Greatn[e]ss called the Great Spirit and the First Man and the gods of the glorious one, who are provided to enable them to reveal him; at that very time [he] sculpted the Great Builder in the [land of] light, [and] the Living Spirit with the mighty and active gods who came [from] him. Also, at that time, he sculpted the [Amb]assador, with Jesus the Splendour and the Virgin of Light and the Pillar of Glory, and the gods who came from them. [All these the Father of Greatness sculpted at] a single time. They came forth of one another, one after one; the time when [...] and the work.

from the time when the Darkness raised itself up to [the] essence of the light [...] these three emanations [came forth] from the will of the Father against the enemy [...] he has [overcome] Darkness [...] according to the will [...] the universe [...] in it [...] separate out [...] rest him in which way, and he rejoices [...] in his kingdom; until [the time when the face] of the Father will be unveiled over [all] the gods of glory, and all the rich ones of [light, and] the em[anations] who came forth against the enemy.

[From] that time when he sculpted these three [emanations] till the time when the Father would unveil his face, [and they] go in to his hidden storehouses, and he calls them [and he] establishes each one of them to his place. There is no measure nor rule to this period until that time.
about this Matter, this thought of death [came to be] ; for [this] is the way that [it] came up to its storehouses. It has [its existence] in its five elements.

Again, it also [spent] the period and the time that it spent, until it revealed itself to its elements, before it came to the trees. It spent a great period and a long time established [in its elements] before it came up to the trees. It was [established] in the trees. It spent a long time and duration [...] existing in them, before it sculpted the fru[its ...] and sculpted the fruits.

Again, it spent a long [time] in the fruits. Not little is the period and the time that it spent existing in the fruits, before it sculpted [the creatures] after a long time [it sculpted] the d[emon]s of its five worlds in various forms [can not] be measured [...] in p[erfec]tion of the fruits in the demons and fiends. They fell upon their earth and [they] were nourished. Not little is the period that they [spent in the wo]rlds, until they were nourished amongst [themselves] to make [war upon] that land which shines, and the great [King] who dwells there.

[You] know that [...] that in [...] at the time when he [raised up] its essence. It assumed [the nature of] Matter [and came] to the war [against] the Perfect Man. [From the time] when the war occurred [...]
[The first is the time when] he came to be in some [...] when they ensnared a [portion of the light]
[The second is the time] that he built [and] the universe was established. The zone [reaches] down until the time when it will be dissolved.
The third is the [time that] the things and the universe will [endure] from the time when they were established there, till the time when their end will be complete and their existence ceases [...]

[The fourth is the dissolution when they will dissolve the universe] there, and all things are destroyed. Obliteration reaches them in that great fire, [which will] burn them for fourteen hundred and sixty-eight years.

[The fift]h is the way that the Last Statue will be sculpted [from] the remnant of all things. The light separates out to its place, and goes up and rules in its kingdom. However, [the da]rkness [is cast down] and they take it in to the tomb [...] and they are bound with it in an eternal chain.
Now, from [the tim]e when this first war occurred, till the time of this chain [...] these five things [belong to the] light.
However, before [all this came] from it out of the powers [no one is able to count] and measure it; because it is eternal.

fills.explanation: Completes "time" and provides the verb: "a time came that they sculpted" — a standard Kephalaia construction introducing a new event in the divine sequence.
Completes "sculpted him and" linking the act of formation to revelation: "they sculpted him and he was revealed in the Father," matching the spiritual reading's sequence of forming and manifesting.
The Father of Greatness issued/made the two summonses; "he made" provides the verb for the temporal clause beginning with "When."
The two summonses were directed "to" the Mother of Life, connecting the verb "called" with its recipient.
The Mother of Life is the subject who spent a long duration within the Father before being summoned forth, paralleling the chapter's theme of long preparation.
Standard Manichaean epithet completing the title "the first Father of Greatness," used throughout the Kephalaia.
The preposition "to" is required to connect "set a measure and rule" with its object "the earth particles."

Parallel structure requires a countable natural element of the sea; "drops" corresponds to individual knowledges (general knowledge body) in the spiritual sense and parallels "pebbles of the mountains."
The preposition "into" connects "poured" with "the body of the four mountains," indicating the direction of the measuring operation.
Completes "poured out into these fine granules," indicating the finest measure to which everything is reduced.
Confirms editor's fill; connects the measurability of earth particles to those of the entire universe, matching the spiritual reading's parallel structure.
Confirms editor's fill; "entire universe" corresponds to the whole spiritual cosmos in the spiritual reading.
Simple conjunction connecting the two countable items: "the particles of the earth each year and the sand grains of the entire universe."
Confirms editor's fill; the definite article introduces "the first established thing," the standard epithet for the primal foundation.
Confirms editor's fill; "they had need of her" is standard Kephalaia idiom expressing the necessity that arose among the divine realm for the Mother of Life to come forth.
Confirms editor's fill; "the Father of Greatness" is the standard title throughout the Kephalaia, corresponding to the Divine Love in his infinite fullness.
Standard Kephalaia doublet for divine proceeding: "called to come forth and go to" — the Mother of Life was summoned to proceed from her place and travel forth.
The Mother of Life bestowed "her light" upon the First Man's body, corresponding to the spiritual reading's "she bestowed" divine truth upon the ordered form.
Parallel preposition creating: "she gave her light upon his body and upon all the aeons of light" — bestowing upon both the First Man and all the luminous states.
Directly parallels ¶5's "her aeons of light"; "aeons of light" is the standard phrase for the eternal luminous states of wisdom.
The spiritual reading says "pervaded all of them"; the natural-plane correspondent is "filled," indicating the Mother of Life permeated all the aeons with her presence.
Confirms editor's fill; standard transitional phrase linking the Mother of Life's formation to the parallel account of the First Man.
Directly parallels ¶5's phrase "in his inner storehouses in quiet and silence"; the same formula of peaceful preparation recurs for the First Man's anointing in the Mother.
Confirms editor's fill; the five sons of the First Man are consistently called "gods" in the Kephalaia, corresponding to five faculties of good.
Confirms editor's fill; "at the time when" is the standard temporal construction in the Kephalaia.

Confirms editor's fill; the Mother's descent from the heights to the earth is expressed in concrete temporal quantities ("thousands of years"), the natural equivalent of traversing innumerable states.
Confirms editor's fill; introduces the comparative structure: "just as he had called her... so he set her upon."
Confirms editor's fill; the definite article introduces "the land of greatness," the plane of divine fullness.
Confirms editor's fill; the definite article begins the new section: "The matter of the Mother of Life is like this."

fills.explanation: Confirms editor's fill; describes the Father's sovereign act of summoning and establishing the Mother in the state of his choosing, matching the spiritual reading's "the Divine Love summoned her, he established her in the state he willed."
The preposition "in" completes the simile: "that in a blink of an eye," describing instantaneous divine perception.
The adjective "swift" modifies "bird" in the natural register, corresponding to instantaneous thought of the rational mind; birds = thoughts in Swedenborgian correspondence.
Completes "like the matter of the Mother of Life," echoing ¶10's phrasing "The matter of the Mother of Life is like this" and matching the spiritual reading's "like the nature of the."
The Father of Greatness is the agent who sends the Mother of Life forth, paralleling ¶9–10 where the Father calls and establishes her: "whenever the Father cast her out."
Echoes the chapter's own repeated formula: "the place he pleased" appears in ¶10 and ¶11's reconstructed bracket, so "to the place that pleased him" is internally consistent.
Confirms editor's fill; "according to his will" expresses the divine purpose by which the Father establishes each entity in its proper place.
Confirms editor's fill; "This also is how" introduces a parallel account of the five gods being called forth, maintaining the chapter's structural pattern.
Completes the verb phrase before "down": the First Man wished that the quality "should go down" to the contest, matching the spiritual reading's "should descend."
Confirms editor's fill; "a long period and time" is the standard Kephalaia doublet expressing a vast duration.
Confirms editor's fill; the pronoun "he" refers to the Father of Greatness who sculpted all divine agents.
Confirms editor's fill; "the land of light" is the standard Manichaean phrase for the plane of divine truth where the Great Builder was formed.
Confirms editor's fill; the conjunction "and" connects the Great Builder to the Living Spirit in the list of sculpted divine agents.
Confirms editor's fill; "who came from him" describes the proceeding of the active gods from the Living Spirit.

fills.explanation: Confirms editor's fill; summarizes the simultaneous formation of all three emanations by the Father of Greatness, matching the spiritual reading's "All these the Divine Love in his infinite nature formed at a single act."
The definite article completes "raised itself up to the essence of the light," describing Darkness attacking the very substance of the divine realm.
"Came forth" is the standard Kephalaia verb for emanations proceeding from a source: "these three emanations came forth from the will of the Father against the enemy."
Matches the spiritual reading's "overcome falsity"; in the natural register: "he has overcome Darkness" describes the Father's victory through the three emanations.
Confirms editor's fill; "the face of the Father" corresponds to the inmost divine nature being unveiled, consistent with Swedenborgian correspondence where "face" = interior nature.
Confirms editor's fill; "over all the gods of glory" indicates the universal scope of the Father's unveiling.
Completes "the rich ones of light" and transitions to "the emanations" — two groups who receive the Father's unveiled face; "light" is the standard qualifier for divine wealth.
Confirms editor's fill; "From that time" begins the temporal frame marking the full duration from formation to final unveiling.
The "three emanations" are named explicitly in ¶15 and recur here; these are the three divine processions (evocations) sculpted by the Father.
Confirms editor's fill; "and they go in to his hidden storehouses" describes the emanations returning to the Father's interior states.
Connects "he calls them" to "establishes each one" with parallel subject: "he calls them and he establishes each one of them to his place."
Introduces the origin of evil: "this thought of death came to be; for this is the way that it came up to its storehouses," setting up ¶20–22's account of Matter's progressive development.
Confirms editor's fill; "for this is the way" introduces the explanation of how Matter/Darkness arose.
The pronoun "it" refers to Matter/Darkness, the subject throughout ¶20–22: "the way that it came up to its storehouses."
Matches the spiritual reading's "its existence in its five fundamental aspects of evil"; Matter has its existence (being) distributed across five dark elements.
The verb "spent" connects "it also" to "the period and the time," continuing the chapter's recurring formula of long durations before each stage.
Matter was established "in its elements" before rising to the trees, paralleling the earlier mention of "its five elements" and the spiritual reading's "in its own aspects."
Parallels the recurring "established" terminology throughout the chapter; Matter was established (set/active) in the trees before sculpting fruits.
Confirms editor's fill; "a long time" continues the chapter's standard temporal formula for durations of evil's development.
In the Manichaean progression, Matter sculpted intermediate forms (creatures) between fruits and demons: "before it sculpted the creatures, after a long time it sculpted the demons."
Restores the verb for the clause: "after a long time it sculpted the demons of its five worlds," continuing the sequence of Matter's progressive formations.
Confirms editor's fill; "in various forms that can not be measured" expresses the innumerable manifestations of evil that exceed all reckoning.
The pronoun "they" restores the subject: "and they were nourished," referring to the demons who fell upon their earth.
The demons were nourished "amongst themselves" in their own domains before desiring the land of light.
In Manichaean cosmology, the demons desired and attacked the realm of light; "to make war upon that land which shines" describes their aggressive desire toward the divine realm.
Confirms editor's fill; "the great King who dwells there" is the Father of Greatness/sovereign good dwelling in the Land of Light.
Confirms editor's fill; "You know that" is the standard Kephalaia address from Mani to his disciples.
Parallels ¶15's "the Darkness raised itself up"; here the evil entity "raised up its essence" in preparation for war against the Perfect Man.
Directly mirrors the spiritual reading's "the nature of evil": "It assumed the nature of Matter and came to the war against the Perfect Man."
Connects Matter's assumption of power to its assault: "Matter and came to the war against the Perfect Man," matching the spiritual reading's "went to the assault."
The preposition "against" connects "to the war" with "the Perfect Man," describing Matter's assault on the Complete Spiritual Human.
Confirms editor's fill; "From the time when the war occurred" begins the temporal frame for the five ages, the chapter's standard construction.

fills.fill: The first is the time when
fills.explanation: Follows the structural pattern of the five ages ("The [ordinal] is the [noun] [relative clause]"); the first age is the initial period of encounter and ensnaring.
Standard Manichaean language for the first age: the powers of Darkness ensnared "a portion of the light" — the captured luminous elements that became mixed with Matter.
Parallel structure to the other ages; the second age is the period of cosmic building/ordering: "The second is the time that he built."
The conjunction "and" connects the building act to the establishment of the universe: "that he built and the universe was established."
The verb "reaches" describes the zone's spatial extent downward: "The zone reaches down until the time when it will be dissolved."
Completes "The third is the time that the things and the universe will endure," defining the third age as the duration of the cosmos.
The verb "endure" describes the persistence of all things from establishment to final dissolution, matching the spiritual reading's "endure."

fills.explanation: Confirms editor's fill; the fourth age describes the cosmic dissolution, when all created reality is dissolved in consuming fire.

The five ages belong to the light's narrative of separation and liberation: "these five things belong to the light," matching the spiritual reading's "pertain to the progressive separation of wisdom."
